questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming vehicles. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to show that left-turning vehicles must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning, even on a green light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that parking in this area is not allowed. Your vehicle will be towed if you park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop completely if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right on a red light at this traffic signal. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: A curve is coming. The arrow shows which direction the road curves. Driving at 35 mph or slower is recommended for that curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: An overpass with low clearance is ahead. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is extended upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you are behind this driver, be ready for them to turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign is a rule that you must follow. You cannot make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: The shoulder ahead is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for vehicles turning left from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and be prepared for sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for red lights, react to yellow lights, or continue through green lights and watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of an area with low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the shoulder is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that you must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that you must follow. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming steep hill. Prepare to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before proceeding.
